execution_scope: Repository path existence, filename/extension check, inventory/source-ID reconciliation, duplicate physical-file mapping; no content access
required_preconditions: S1 planning artifacts frozen and synced (already satisfied)
success_criteria: every target's recorded path_exists/verification_status is reconfirmed as of this cycle with zero discrepancy from the frozen inventories
stop_conditions: stop if any target's path_exists disagrees with the frozen inventory record
rollback_boundary: no file is opened, moved, or modified; this batch only re-runs existence checks already reflected in the frozen CSVs

execution_scope: External and local metadata-only identity confirmation for sources whose bibliographic identity is not yet established (edition, compiler, institution)
required_preconditions: S1-B0 complete; separate authorization granted for external bibliographic lookups
success_criteria: each target's bibliographic identity is either confirmed against an external catalog/record or explicitly logged as unresolved
stop_conditions: stop on any target where no external record can be found within this batch's authorized scope
rollback_boundary: no local file changes; only identity-review rows are produced, discardable without side effects

execution_scope: Opening and indexing local file content (CD1-CD6, Het Painansch Contract, Kathirithamby-Wells 1976) to build position-level indexes
required_preconditions: S1-B1 complete for the same targets; separate authorization granted for local content access
success_criteria: a document/date/place/actor/position index exists for each target, or the target is explicitly logged as not-yet-indexable
stop_conditions: stop if a target's bibliographic identity from S1-B1 was not confirmed before indexing begins
rollback_boundary: no source file is modified; only index rows are produced, discardable without side effects

execution_scope: Acquisition or continued search for sources with no local copy (Veevers, EIC Fort York/Batang Capas, Kathirithamby PhD thesis, Vogel, Batangkapas antecedent)
required_preconditions: S1-B1 identity review complete for the same targets; separate authorization granted for external retrieval or user-supplied source intake
success_criteria: each target is either acquired and hash-verified against its known bibliographic identity, or explicitly logged as MISSING_LOCAL_COPY/user-supply-required
stop_conditions: stop and log as unavailable if no matching source can be acquired within this batch's authorized scope
rollback_boundary: delete any acquired file that fails identity verification against its known citation

execution_scope: Tracing repository-derived artifacts (Painan JSON, working CSVs, Indrapura dossier) back to their underlying primary/secondary source chain
required_preconditions: S1-B1/B2 identity and indexing work complete for the primary sources these artifacts cite (CD4, Vogel, PS-01, PS-02)
success_criteria: every record/claim in each derived artifact either resolves to a specific source_id and position, or is explicitly flagged as unsourced
stop_conditions: stop and flag as unsourced any record that cannot be traced to a source_id in the frozen inventories
rollback_boundary: no source or derived-artifact file is modified; only audit rows are produced

execution_scope: Formal adoption of source-position citation rules, admissibility gates, and the empty claim-source-ledger instantiation plan (S1-WP10, S1-WP11, S1-WP12; no retrieval_id exists for these)
target_ids: NONE (operates on S1-WP10, S1-WP11, S1-WP12; no retrieval-target IDs apply)
required_preconditions: S1-B1 through S1-B4 complete, so the rules can be calibrated against actual retrieval/indexing experience
success_criteria: the admissibility rules and citation-position rules already drafted in S1_SOURCE_ADMISSIBILITY_AND_PROMOTION_RULES.md are formally adopted, and the empty claim-source ledger file is instantiated with zero data rows
stop_conditions: stop if any prerequisite gate (S1-B1..B4) has not completed for the sources a claim would cite
rollback_boundary: delete the empty ledger file if instantiated in error; no historical data exists to roll back
